name: masked-notes
description: One entity with a hidden field and rules that permit every caller, so a fact about the hidden field's NAME is not also a fact about the caller's access. The carve-out being tested: a hidden field's name must stay indistinguishable from an unknown one, because Task 8 excludes it from the published document while the rest of the declared shape is public.

notes.description: A note with one field the descriptor author marked confidential.
